static_traits.name: Chen Siyuan
static_traits.social_status: Has some friends to talk to, but hesitates to share feelings of inferiority
static_traits.medical_history: No significant physical illness; not yet received psychotherapy; no similar problem history
static_traits.language_features: clear expression, highly cooperative,Positive attitude; capable of self-Reflection, but with self-deprecation (e.g. 'I am useless') and black-and-white expressions

basic_info.main_problem: feeling inadequate and 'useless' for not being able to finish a beloved fantasy novel.
basic_info.core_demands: Needs help dealing with own high expectations and self-criticism.

core_beliefs: as long as I have not met expectations,I am just a failure

special_situations.event: not yet finishing a beloved fantasy novel
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: if I cannot finish reading as planned, it means I am incompetent/useless
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Sets higher reading goals and forces self to finish faster to prove oneself

special_situations.event: Encountering small setbacks in daily activities
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: any setback means I am overall not capable
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: constantly pressuring oneself, forcing harder effort to avoid failure
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I cannot even do small things well, I will never do anything well.

special_situations.event: when thinking of sharing inadequacies and emotions with friends
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: if inadequacies are exposed, others will look down on me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids sharing, hides emotions to protect one's image
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will think I am terrible.

special_situations.event: associating future achievements after not yet finishing a book
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: failure in one area predicts future failures in all areas
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Using self-criticism to push oneself to meet standards
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I cannot even finish a book, how can I achieve anything?

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized, to be seen as a capable and valuable person
core_conflict.fear: fear of being looked down on and negated, fear of failure exposing incompetence
defense_goal: Maintains high standards to avoid failure and judgment
reducing exposure of vulnerability and inadequacy to protect self-esteem

object_relations.object_representation: Others (such as friends) who would evaluate and look down on me

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: when tasks are not yet completed or progress is asked about
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: believing failure proves oneself utterly worthless, and worrying others will look down on oneself for it
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: gentle and supportive tone, normalizing failure and setbacks; encouraging concretizing and operationalizing problems, avoiding judgment; inviting them to identify emotions and needs, and Guiding them with open questions to distinguish facts from self-labels.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: when thinking of sharing inadequacies or emotions with friends
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: believing friends will look down on oneself (transference: Projecting self-criticism as others' judgment)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Maintains an accepting attitude, invites her to examine the evidence and conduct small-step behavioral experiments to test hypotheses; encourages trying to express true feelings in safe situations.

manifestations: hesitant about sharing self-inadequacies with friends, worrying about being looked down on
outcomes: Social avoidance and insufficient use of the support system

manifestations: High expectations and self-blame limit spontaneity and flexible choices
outcomes: Rigid behavior, reduced tolerance for experiences

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: frequent self-blame, labeling oneself with 'I am useless'
Over-scrutinizes own performance over small setbacks

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: daring not to share for fear friends will look down on oneself
Presets negative evaluations of himself as others' opinions

contact_model.definition: The individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: turning stress and dissatisfaction onto oneself, forcing task completion through pressure and self-criticism

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: treating rules like 'must complete tasks' 'cannot fail' as absolute standards
Uses high expectations as the sole measure of self-worth

positive_force: Open to behavioral experiments and willing to record data
Has some social support (friends to talk with)
negative_force: cognitive distortions like black-and-white, overgeneralization and predicting the future
Avoids expressing oneself and asking for help for fear others will look down on them
After setbacks, copes by pressuring, causing stress accumulation

target_behavior.behavior: self-deprecation and Catastrophizing when tasks are not yet completed
antecedent: not yet finishing a beloved fantasy novel
Encountering small setbacks in daily activities
target_behavior.core_reason: Holds excessively high expectations of oneself, producing cognitive distortions such as black-and-white thinking, overgeneralization, and labeling
target_behavior.function: Tries to motivate oneself through self-criticism and avoid facing external evaluation
target_behavior.consequence: Low mood, heightened Sense of frustration, daily life disrupted

target_behavior.behavior: Avoiding sharing feelings and needs with friends
antecedent: Thinking that friends might look down on oneself
Facing situations where support is needed
target_behavior.core_reason: fear of being negated and shame, mind-reading and dependence on external evaluation
target_behavior.function: Escapes potential criticism or embarrassment; maintains self-esteem in the short term
target_behavior.consequence: worsening loneliness,Social support hard to work, problems persisting
